==== src/VerifySample.Tests/ModuleInitializer.cs

// Generated by the Verify wizard: https://verifytests.github.io/Wizard/new?step=output&os=Windows&ide=Rider&cli=Cli&tf=XunitV3&ci=GitHubActions&ext=Pandoc&min=Pandoc&sponsor=Exempt&exempt=OpenSource&until=2027-09
// Delete whatever is not needed.
using System.Runtime.CompilerServices;

// Everything here runs once, when the test assembly loads, before any test.
public static class ModuleInitializer
{
    [ModuleInitializer]
    public static void Initialize()
    {
        // Initializes every Verify.* plugin the project references and has not initialized above.
        // Explicit calls come first so their parameters apply: a plugin can only be initialized once.
        VerifierSettings.InitializePlugins();
    }
}

==== src/VerifySample.Tests/Extensions/PandocTests.cs

// Generated by the Verify wizard: https://verifytests.github.io/Wizard/new?step=output&os=Windows&ide=Rider&cli=Cli&tf=XunitV3&ci=GitHubActions&ext=Pandoc&min=Pandoc&sponsor=Exempt&exempt=OpenSource&until=2027-09
// Delete whatever is not needed.
// Verify.Pandoc: Converts docx and rtf documents to markdown through pandoc, and verifies the markdown.
// https://github.com/VerifyTests/Verify.Pandoc
// Note: The supported inputs are docx and rtf. Both produce one md target, so this never collides
// with the pdf or image extensions.
// Note: The Pandoc package it depends on brings a second SponsorCheck gate, for the owner
// Papyrine, so the project needs Papyrine_ prefixed sponsorship properties as well as Verify's
// own.
// Note: The samples read sample.docx and sample.rtf from the output directory. Add them with a
// None Update item and CopyToOutputDirectory=PreserveNewest.
// Note: It owns the docx converter, so it cannot be combined with another extension that also
// converts docx.
// Note: VerifyPandoc exposes only Initialize(): there are no settings methods or scrubbers.
// Note: Verify.Pandoc is pre 1.0 (0.1.1).
public class PandocTests
{
    // A docx is converted to markdown and verified as a single .verified.md, so the snapshot is
    // the readable content rather than the package's xml.
    // Not run by default: needs pandoc installed and a sample.docx in the test project's output
    // directory.
    [Fact(Skip = "needs pandoc installed and a sample.docx in the test project's output directory.")]
    public Task Word()
    {
        return VerifyFile("sample.docx");
    }

    // rtf is the other supported input, and converts to markdown the same way.
    // Not run by default: needs pandoc installed and a sample.rtf in the test project's output
    // directory.
    [Fact(Skip = "needs pandoc installed and a sample.rtf in the test project's output directory.")]
    public Task Rtf()
    {
        return VerifyFile("sample.rtf");
    }
}


==== packages

Verify.XunitV3
xunit.v3
Verify.Pandoc

==== interactions

Warning external-tool: Pandoc needs Pandoc: PandocNet shells out to the pandoc executable, so pandoc has to be installed on the machine running the tests.
Warning external-tool: Pandoc needs Papyrine sponsorship declaration: The Pandoc package this depends on ships a second SponsorCheck gate, for the owner Papyrine. Without Papyrine_ prefixed sponsorship properties the build fails, on top of Verify's own Verify_ properties.
Warning transitive-sponsorship: Pandoc carries an Open Source Maintenance Fee check of its own, for Papyrine, and Papyrine does not offer the exemption claimed for Verify, and accepts only SmallRevenue and MaintainerConsulting. The generated Directory.Build.props has that owner's options commented out; until one is chosen the build fails with SC021.
